headline: Ruiz Biotech Revenue: First Three Quarters at NT$610 Million, Up 70%; US Market Respiratory Testing Demand Surges
summary: Ruiz Biotech said its first three quarters revenue reached NT$610 million, up 70%. Demand for respiratory testing in North America is rising as laboratory clients prepare for flu season.
why: Ruiz Biotech is a Taiwan-listed diagnostic test maker, and its results reflect demand for respiratory testing in its North American customer base.
